messages:
oncall-bot: PAGING: GPU pool 'gpu-prod-1' capacity alarm triggered (100% utilization), queue growth > 500 requests over 5m. Priority: P1. Paging on-call: @maya

maya: on it. seeing a spike in router queue length and a slew of 429s in the logs. tagging infra + runtime.

jamal: I can help with quick triage. can someone confirm whether HPA target pods count has changed?

maya: checking...
- kubectl get hpa -n inference gpu-runtime-hpa

maya: HPA shows replicas=4 current=2 desired=8 but lastScaleTime is 12m ago. prometheus adapter metrics for custom/hpa-gpu are flat.

oliver: that smells like metrics delay. metrics-server is healthy?

paul-runtime: metrics-server on k8s nodes healthy from the probe. but prometheus-adapter logs show repeated 503s to prometheus-query-service starting ~10:40 UTC.

metrics-bot: ALERT: prom-adapter-query-error rate increased to 72% (10m).

maya: I'm seeing backlog in the metrics adapter queue: 'adapter_queue_length: 2400'. adapter pod is OOM restarting intermittently. config shows query timeout 5s.

oliver: if the adapter isn't publishing custom metrics, HPA won't scale. we need a manual scale to buy time.

jamal: agreed. increasing replicas of gpu-runtime deployment to 10 (manual).

maya: running:

```
kubectl scale deploy gpu-runtime -n inference --replicas=10
```

maya: scaled to 10. routing shows a drop in 429s from 18% -> 6% over the last 60s. queue still high but rate dropped.

paul-runtime: runtime reports many queued sessions with large KV-caches; new pods are joining but kube-scheduler is slower than usual due to gpuctl plugin delays. infra-cc?

infra-lead: seeing a surge of pods pending due to node group hitting instance quota in eu-west-1. autoscaler could not provision more nodes. filing quota request is slow.

oliver: can we scale to a different GPU pool or failover to lower-capacity model variant for non-SLAd customers?

maya: routing policy supports fallback to 'gpu-prod-2' but that pool is in a different region (us-east). latency will increase for affected customers.

jamal: let's route non-enterprise traffic to cpu-fallback or smaller model. apply temporary routing rule now.

maya: applying route change for general pool:

```
PATCH /routing/policies/active
{ "match": "tier==free || tier==standard", "target": "cpu-fallback" }
```

maya: route change applied. traffic for free/standard tiers dropped 60% to cpu-fallback. overall request queue for gpu-prod-1 reduced by ~40%.

metrics-bot: NOTE: customer-impact tag added: affected_customers=32, high_latency=true, request_errors=temporarily_rerouted

paul-runtime: runtime team confirms no model degradation for enterprise tier (kept on gpu-prod-1). enterprise latency shows 10% tail increase. customers alerted via status page?

oliver: status page updated with 'degraded performance for subset of tenants in EU region; we are mitigating'.

maya: next step: stabilize metrics-adapter. I'll restart prometheus-adapter with increased memory and bump query timeout to 15s.

maya: commands:

```
kubectl set resources deploy prometheus-adapter -n monitoring --limits=memory=1Gi --requests=memory=512Mi
kubectl rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring
```

sophia: I'll monitor adapter logs and tail queries. also checking Prometheus ingestion latency for custom metrics.

metrics-bot: prom_adapter_log: "query to prometheus timed out" at 10:41:32 UTC repeated 47 times.

paul-runtime: after restart, adapter memory usage stabilized. custom metrics are now being emitted again. HPA metrics for gpu-runtime show update: current=7 desired=12.

maya: good. HPA should reconcile. if not, we'll keep manual replicas until autoscaler recovers.

jamal: I see HPA has now scaled to 12. queue drains, 429s back to <1% over 3m.

infra-lead: quota request acknowledged; we got a short-term bump for instance pool to bring up nodes. autoscaler resuming normal behavior.

maya: customer impact summary so far: 32 customers affected (non-enterprise), partial request reroute to cpu-fallback causing increased latency for those tenants, enterprise customers had elevated tail latency ~10% but no errors. No data loss.

oliver: assigning post-incident actions: 1) increase prometheus-adapter resource requests and circuit-breaker defaults. 2) add alert for adapter_queue_length > 500. 3) add autocapacity failover policy to route to secondary GPU pool before manual routing. 4) review HPA metric scrape timeouts and recommend default 15s.

maya: handing off to next on-call: @sophia will take post-mortem ownership and follow up with infra + runtime. I'm paged out.

sophia: taking handoff. I'll open the incident ticket, collect logs, and schedule a follow-up with infra-lead and paul-runtime for RCA.

metrics-bot: Incident closed for now: mitigation=manual_scale + routing_fallback + adapter_restart, time_to_mitigate=18m.

sophia: planned follow-ups: collect adapter heap profiles, increase adapter HA (replicas), verify HPA targets under Prometheus load, automate routing fallback in console. Creating runbook changes now.

maya: thanks everyone.

oliver: left a note: consider slow query detection in Prometheus query-service; it contributed to adapter timeouts.

paul-runtime: runtime team to add graceful degradation to smaller KV caches under high queue to reduce pod memory pressure.

sophia: closing handoff.
